beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, was dragged before the council for speaking the truth. He told them the whole story of Israel — and they boiled with rage.

timing.text: Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, was dragged before the council for speaking the truth.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But Stephen didn't look at his accusers. He looked up, and what he saw changed everything.

timing.text: But Stephen didn't look at his accusers.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He saw the glory of God — and Jesus, standing at the right hand of the Father. And he said so, out loud:

timing.text: He saw the glory of God — and Jesus, standing at the right hand of the Father.
And he said so, out loud:

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.

timing.text: Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: They would not hear it. They rushed him out.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But Stephen's face was the face of an angel — at peace, not afraid.

timing.text: But Stephen's face was the face of an angel — at peace, not afraid.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then he knelt down, with the stones still coming, and his last words asked mercy for the ones throwing them.

timing.text: Then he knelt down, with the stones still coming, and his last words asked mercy for the ones throwing them.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Lord, lay not this sin to their charge.

timing.text: Lord, lay not this sin to their charge.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Don't hold this against them, he prayed. Then the stones killed him, but they could not take away his peace.
